overview_description.description:
We are changing the way investment managers interact with financial analytics. From one-size-doesn't-fit-all to highly customizable and blazing fast.
Our first goal is to revolutionize equity risk models and analytics. Traditional models don't align with realistic investment universes or styles - we're changing that.
We aim to be the one stop shop analytics provider for the modern investment manager. All asset classes, all strategies, all in one place.

about_short_description.short_description: Bayesline delivers highly customizable and blazing fast analytics to asset managers and asset owners.

product.name: ALEX - AI-Leveraged Exposures
product.description: A tool that uses AI to assess exposure to market themes and events by analyzing company filings and research reports.

product.name: Custom Risk Models
product.description: A service allowing users to build tailored risk models using a platform with API or GUI, including risk decomposition and value at risk analytics.

product.name: Strategic Asset Allocation Planning
product.description: An API-based service for creating long-term asset allocation plans, incorporating private assets and optimizing for risk and return.

product.name: Free Tier Platform
product.description: A platform offering free access to build custom risk models and view analytics using a sample dataset of US equities.

product.name: Enterprise Tier Services
product.description: Advanced services including cloud deployment, vendor data integration, and custom reporting for enterprise clients.
